scope: Retrospective registered granule-cell response transfer from 1-second to 2-second dopamine reward delay; not CF, water, new-mouse transfer, author-figure reconstruction or causal prediction.
cohort: Every GrCs=Y, Delay=2 dirTable row with chronicGreen; unique same-mouse/same-DAType Delay=1 row DA_Dir equals target Alt_Delay_Dir. No favorable session/cell subset.
registration: finalMatchesMat exactly two columns of nonnegative integers. Orient by distinct column maxima matching the two session nc_right_green counts, as author MainData.m does; require unique orientation and unique positive values per column. Retain every row with both cells positive, excluding only structurally unmatched zero rows. Ambiguous orientation, duplicate positive IDs or out-of-bounds IDs block whole-cohort preparation.
trials: Every recorded trial; no rewarded/goodMvmt/reliability/response-magnitude selection. Missing or nonfinite matched calcium blocks preparation for the full cohort; report exact gap rather than silently exclude.

clock.interpolation: linear per trial/cell on tmpx_right; no extrapolation; full native support0..3seconds required

split.source_calibration: first floor(0.8*N) whole trials in release order
split.query: all whole2s-condition trials, never split across public/private response windows
split.condition_holdout: entire2s neural trajectories private; no query neural/movement/lick/outcome values
split.final_refit: all public1s calibration+validation trials after method selection
split.no_temporal_claim: Source order chronological only if source trial-order provenance confirms it; until verified label as source-order split, not chronological.

public_inputs: registered opaque cell IDs, pair/query IDs, time grid, planned2s delay and DAT/MFB type; full1s training/validation calcium. No treatment-coded paths or actualrewarded/sol/success/futurebehavior.

primary.name: mouse_macro_training_scale_NRMSE
primary.per_pair: sqrt(mean((prediction-target)^2 over querytrials, registeredcells,61times)/mean((train-train_cell_mean)^2 over all publicsource trials,cells,times))
primary.train_cell_mean: per-cell mean over allpublic1s trials andtimebins
primary.aggregation: Preserve pooled pair RMSE/training-scale ratio exactly: equal cells/trials/times inside each pair MSE and pooled scale, then equal pair NRMSEs within mouse and equal mice. This is not the mean of per-cell NRMSEs. Recurrent components can receive repeated weight through pairs.
primary.zero_training_scale: undefined full primary; no epsilon or favorable subset

diagnostics: raw RMSE and target-cell-centered R2 per pair; zero target variance undefined
absolute_mean: all-public 1s mean trajectory at identical movement-end time
fixed_warp_mean: source-only fixed piecewise warp on the same 61 query times
paired candidate-minus-absolute, candidate-minus-fixed-warp, and fixed-warp-minus-absolute NRMSE per pair and mouse; macro with unchanged primary support
leave-one-mouse values with the same pair/mouse recipe; one-mouse omission gives undefined rather than empty average
complete operator-private pair/session/cell-component/trial graph, recurring component appearances and unique/reused source-trial support
component-balanced sensitivity explicitly not implemented: a separate normalization/estimand must be selected before use

baseline.absolute_mean: Mean over every public calibration+validation source trial, per cell/time; no target calibration.

fixed_warp_mean.formula: mu1(g(t)); g(t)=t/2 for0<=t<2 and g(t)=t-1 for2<=t<=3
fixed_warp_mean.boundary: Use postreward branch at t=2; both branches give1s continuously.
fixed_warp_mean.support: Compute mean on candidate-visible source grid0..3s, then linearly interpolate within that grid; identical query grid0..3s and all registered cells/trials for both comparators.

baseline.execution: Prepared only in future authorized preparation; errors computed only in future authorized grading. No comparator result on authentic inputs exists.

limitations: Processed calcium may use whole-session normalization/noncausal filtering; not strictonlineforecast.
Registration itself uses bothsessions; allsource data historicallypublic.
No movement/lick conditional controls in this narrowerplannedconditiononly task; not beyondmovement inference.
Source-order chronology unverified; target condition remains completely held out.
Cohort/array/clock/NaN geometry not verified until bothrequiredMATparts acquired.
estimand: Expected registered GrC trajectory across every trial in the unknown outcome mixture; distinct from the published rewarded-trial averages. Planned-condition inputs only; no reward-coding independence inference.
cohort_reporting: Raw projection v2 preserves every source-session structural disposition and every oriented registration row, including zero-sided rows. Every required selected pair must pass or preparation refuses; no unsupported pair is silently dropped.

operator_binding.public_and_submission_schemas: unchanged v1; no query behavior/outcome added
operator_binding.report_privacy: Complete grade and support report remain operator-private; raw biological identities are never candidate inputs.
